5V5 BOMB DEFUSAL · MAP: SANDLINE

Strikers attack and plant the bomb on site A or B. Wardens defend and defuse. First to 13 rounds wins; sides swap after round 12.
WASD move
Mouse look, Left fire, Right scope / stab / short throw
Shift walk quietly
Ctrl or C crouch
Space jump (crouch in the air to crouch-jump)
R reload
1–5 or wheel switch weapon
Q last weapon
G drop weapon
E pick up / defuse / plant
B buy menu
Tab scoreboard
Esc pause
Plant: hold 5 (bomb) + left click, or hold E on site.
Defuse: hold E at the bomb (5 s with a kit).
Pull the mouse down while spraying to control recoil. Standing still makes the first shot accurate.
Original game: names, map and art are made for this project. Ctrl+W closes browser tabs, so the game runs fullscreen with the keyboard locked when your browser allows it; C also crouches.
